Snacks

Soft apple oat squares

Zabos szelet

8 months+ Replaced 25 min 8 portions

Cut soft squares and serve them the day they are baked if you can. They should not chew like a dried bar.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g Rolled oats (Fine or ordinary)
  • 1 large Eating apple (Peeled and grated)
  • 100 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mix the oats, grated apple, and milk.
  3. Press the mix firmly into a small tin.
  4. Bake until just set, about 15 minutes.
  5. Cool in the tin and cut into soft squares that press in, not chewy-hard bars.

Replaced

The usual muesli bar uses honey and chopped nuts. Whole nuts are a choking food, and honey is not used.

Press oats, grated apple, and milk into squares and bake until just set, not chewy-hard. Add no honey and no whole nuts.
